paragraph: In a random sample of 400 of this year's 12,000 leak repairs, 94.5% were completed within the 24-hour standard (95% interval 92.2% to 96.5%). Contractor A met the standard more often than contractor B by 1.6 percentage points, a gap that could easily arise by chance (permutation p = 0.52; 95% interval -2.8 to +6.5 points). The population these numbers describe is the repairs logged this year at Zulal, including tickets that were closed late in the system. The sample cannot tell whether a late ticket was a late repair or a late entry, and it cannot show that the two contractors are equal: a gap of a few points either way remains possible.
